decision_question: Can deterministic truth packages preserve authoritative source-linked ground truth while models contribute only optional natural-language variants and advisory review?
ground_truth_policy: Canonical questions, answers, actions, claims, and citations are deterministic. Model output cannot create or modify ground truth.

prospective_boundary_correction.reason: The frozen composition defines cross-course confusion as one of 2,000 boundary cases; the successor therefore forces empty lineage instead of answering from another course.

truth_package_contract.boundary_lineage_policy: selected_claim_ids, citations, structured_target_claims, candidate_claims, and context_source_ids are always empty when expected_action is abstain, clarify, or refuse

wording_strategies.deterministic-plus-model-question-varian: Keep the deterministic canonical question and answer; a model may propose one question variant that is validated against the fixed truth package.
wording_strategies.multi-model-question-variants: Multiple models may propose question variants, but agreement is advisory and cannot alter the truth package.

decision_rule.provider_free_validation_passes: publish the truth-package design and prepare a separately authorized 100-case wording checkpoint
decision_rule.provider_free_validation_fails: correct deterministic construction before any model or provider call
